phase: P3 standalone operation and protocol prototype

environment.linux: Python 3.12.11, aarch64; installed wheel, UID 65534, ordinary Docker container without host mounts or nested-sandbox privileges

verified: strict bounded JSONL and per-operation response schemas
duplicate keys, invalid numbers, IDs, multiple/truncated/oversized responses rejected
read ranges, hash versions, UTF-8 output bounds, search limits
patch unique matching, atomic replace, mode preservation, failure cleanup and pre-replace change detection
standalone -I -S does not load project json/ssl/socket/sitecustomize modules or PYTHONPATH
controlled HTTP proxy use, disallowed redirect refusal, no direct fallback, bounded and incomplete body handling
not_proven: worker installation and interpreter/library trust inspection
launch inside native sandbox with same per-invocation policy
file tools and AgentRunner file_version integration
TLS CONNECT/certificate verification and DNS/private-address egress acceptance
compressed response support; prototype requests identity and explicitly refuses other encodings
complete resource and concurrency safety or P3/P5 acceptance
earlier_trial: First restricted macOS run: 33 passed and one loopback fixture bind failed with EPERM before fetch; rerun outside enclosing sandbox, followed by final updated 35-case suite. No isolation relaxation in production code.
lint_and_format: all three new Python files pass Ruff lint and format checks
